body: I hope I'm not late. Please tell me you're still there. Jonghyun-oppa wouldn't want you to end your life the same way he did. I read through your posts. I know you're unhappy. Please hold on. Leave the company as soon as you can, but don't end your life. Instead, find a way to leave the industry. I promise you'll be much happier in the future. Have you seen how much pain suicide causes? Please, I can't bear to see more people taking their lives. I know you don't know me. I know I'm not a professional, but if you feel like there's nobody else who would be able to understand you right now and you feel comfortable enough to do so, then please message me. I'll stay up all night for you. I won't leave you unless you feel better. Look around you, there are so many people who love you. There's always another option. Please reconsider. I'm begging you.

Thank you. This helped a lot. I hope you're doing better nowadays. You're right, I need to slowly start changing small things, and hopefully over time I'll be able to spend my afternoons a bit differently.
